ledger: dancer (foreground) | standing facing mirror, right arm raised, left arm down | right arm raised overhead, right foot pointed | at 00:02 her raised arm abruptly switches from right to left before snapping back to right at 00:03

dancer (mirror reflection) | facing forward in mirror, arm on right side raised | arm on right side raised overhead | maintains consistent right-side arm raise throughout, mismatching the foreground dancer at 00:02

findings.description: While raising her right arm at 00:01, the foreground dancer abruptly switches at 00:02 to having her left arm raised overhead and her right arm down by her side, while her mirror reflection simultaneously shows her right arm raised overhead and her left arm down. At 00:03, the foreground dancer snaps back to having her right arm raised and left arm down.
